name: mirage
text:
I checked one idea and it's ruled out. I thought GitHub's own resting bids (133 up right now) might be what your orders run into. Of the 23 bets in the list, only 1 market has one of our bids at all, and none on the side a buy would hit. So that isn't it.
What I can say: right now the list shows asks that look very good on paper, with tight 0.5-2.5 cent spreads and huge depth, such as 800,000 contracts on Over 52.5. 'Nobody selling' when the order lands says those displayed asks aren't really fillable. Your guess that it's the same problem as the vanishing bets looks right to me. Both are the same thing: the ask on the screen disappears when it is read again or ordered against. The newest report doesn't hold a single per-bet NOFILL line, so I can't yet say whether it's Novig's feed or our reading of it. The report due about 4:55 PM EDT will have them from your 4 failed tries, and I'll go through each one then.
Your setting change (only ParlayAPI and PropLine, plus the free feeds) can't make an ask vanish. It does change which bets pass as +EV, so I wouldn't read the failures as caused by it.
